messages:
Alex T: quick follow-up to the RFC  our current private endpoint onboarding relies on cross-account cert copy by the operator. it works but it's fragile and hard to audit. can we simplify the cert propagation path so we don't have to copy long-lived files between accounts?
Maya R: sounds familiar. main concern is rotation + audit trail. if we push signing to customer CP we lose visibility into rotations and revoke events :thinking:
Chen L: what if CP provides a tokenized signing endpoint (short-lived certs issued on CSR + token), exposed over PrivateLink/peering? keeps visibility, avoids S3/file-copy across accounts :thumbsup:
Sasha P: tokenized signing seems promising. still worried about regional outage scenarios  need a fallback if PrivateLink to CP is unreachable. also mTLS between agents and signing API
Alex T: agreed. tentative design: add a lightweight "signing-proxy" API to the private control plane. flow: agent -> token server (our CP issue token) -> agent submits CSR+token -> signing-proxy returns short-lived cert. we log and audit every issuance. removes operator copy path.
Chen L: ops notes: keep in mind SNAT/srcip preservation for some on-prem/on-cloud customers. token auth ok, but we must ensure tenant identity is carried and visible to ops. fallback to peering or cached certs when network path is broken.
InfraBot: deploy reminder: canary rollout for signing-proxy scheduled tomorrow 2026-03-24 09:00 PDT. command: ```infra deploy canary --service signing-proxy --env staging```
Maya R: security caveats: tokens must be least-privileged, short TTL. rotate root CA more frequently if CP is issuing leafs. require mTLS between signing-proxy and agents, and store audit logs in immutable storage.
Alex T: tradeoffs: increases CP surface area (new API) but simplifies onboarding and reduces ops complexity at agent level. longer-term goal: deprecate operator file-copy path. action items: @Chen L spike proxy + sample token flow, @Sasha P define mTLS + fallback semantics, I'll draft RFC addendum by EOW.
Chen L: will spike this week. note for air-gapped/on-prem installs: we may still need a pre-signed URL or an offline signing shim as fallback  will prototype that too :memo:
Sasha P: SGTM. also add SLOs/alerts for signing-proxy (latency + error rate) and a graceful-degrade policy: if signing-proxy unreachable, agents use cached certs and enter read-only until reissued.
Alex T: perfect. filing follow-up ticket INF-8421 with the outline. thanks everyone :rocket:
